summary: Specifies how IS-IS is extended to support Generalized Multi-Protocol Label Switching, including the encodings for advertising link information needed by GMPLS. It builds on the IS-IS traffic engineering extensions. It replaced RFC 4205 and has been updated by several later documents.

eli5.summary: This teaches a routing protocol to describe fancy links, such as optical fibers and time slots, not just regular data pipes, so routers can plan paths over many kinds of networks.
